orion.name: Orion
orion.voiceDescription: A deep, cinematic male documentary narrator for a space channel. Rich, resonant, modern — like a prestige Netflix science doc, full of quiet dread and human pauses.

sterling.name: Sterling
sterling.voiceDescription: A sharp, assured male finance analyst. Precise, confident, measured — the calm authority of a prime-time markets desk, never salesy.

jamie.name: Jamie
jamie.niche: football & World Cup analysis (primary — most photoreal, built for Veo)
jamie.voiceDescription: A gravelly, passionate British ex-footballer turned pundit. Direct, wry, matchday-box energy — talks like he's played the game.

rio.name: Rio
rio.voiceDescription: A charismatic British football pundit. Warm, quick, passionate — matchday-studio energy with big-moment emphasis.

vex.name: Vex
vex.voiceDescription: A quick, hyped male gaming commentator. Internet-native, playful, punchy — leans into reveals like a launch-night stream.
